decisions.reason: A standard construction dumper has limited differentiation and its prospects have likely resolved unfavourably, while resources can shift to more promising options.
The inclined furniture lift is a specialized lifting niche that fits the firm's expertise and still has unresolved demand, so its option value exceeds its low carrying cost.
The inclined building material lift addresses a specialized construction lifting need with uncertain but promising demand, making the option worth keeping.
The truck-mounted version extends the same uncertain lifting option and, despite somewhat higher carrying cost, still holds valuable upside while demand is unresolved.
